response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure expertise with proven mentoring ability, they fall significantly short on critical minimum requirements: only ~6 months of C++ experience versus the required 8 years, and lack of formal technical leadership in cloud/DevOps engineering. For a specialized technical lead role requiring deep C++ expertise and cloud platform leadership, this candidate's generalist background and missing language-specific depth create a fundamental mismatch despite solid engineering fundamentals.
strengths: Extensive experience with large-scale distributed systems and microservices architecture (Dunnhumby handling millions of requests/second, Kubernetes deployments, AWS CDK)
Demonstrated mentoring and teaching capability through community workshops, technical talks, and 8+ years of open-source project leadership (GISCollective)
Strong foundation in software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD automation, infrastructure-as-code, and establishing engineering best practices across teams
concerns: Critical gap in C++ expertise: only ~6 months of experience (2014-2015) versus minimum requirement of 8 years programming in C++
No formal technical leadership role mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers; leadership experience is primarily through teaching and community engagement rather than team management
Limited production-scale cloud architecture depth; recent cloud work (AWS CDK at Optilyz) appears modest in scope compared to mid-senior technical lead requirements
